decision_conditions: <p>In the absence of a Noise Impact Assessment, it has not been demonstrated to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority that the proposed Garden Store and plant room projection would not result in any adverse noise impact for the neighbouring property at Wayside, 1 Oak Tree Close, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024),&nbsp; policies D3 (D.7) and D14 of the London Plan (2021), policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies (2013) and&nbsp;the Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>

<p>The proposal, by reason of the increase in depth and width of the proposed rear patio and its siting, in combination with the height of the patio and the privacy screen would result in the perception of a rear extension that is located in close proximity to the rear garden boundaries of&nbsp; neighbouring properties at Wayside, 1 Oak Tree Close and Woodspring, 3 Oak Tree Close. This would result in an adverse overbearing impact, loss of outlook and harm to the visual amenity of the neighbouring occupiers, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policy D3 (D.7) of the London Plan (2021), policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies (2013) and the Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>
